summary: Tabs whose underline is forty pixels that stream from the old tab to the new one, with panels that slide in from the side.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab (an item's `value`, or its `label`). Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs: `{ value?: string; label: string; count?: string | number; content: React.ReactNode }`. `value` defaults to `label`; `count` adds a small badge after the label.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user selects another tab by click or key.

keyboard.action: Select and focus the next / previous tab, wrapping.
Select and focus the first / last tab.

accessibility: Tabs are native buttons with `role="tab"` and `aria-selected` in a `role="tablist"`, with roving tabindex: only the selected tab is in the tab order.
Each tab points to its panel with `aria-controls`. Panels have `role="tabpanel"`, are labelled by their tab through `aria-labelledby` and have `tabindex="0"`; inactive panels are `hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the underline jumps to the new tab and the panel appears without sliding in.
notes: Every panel stays mounted; inactive ones are hidden, so their state survives switching tabs.
Selecting the tab that is already selected does nothing.
